title: High-Accuracy, Real-Time Optimal-Gridding and Uncertainty-Aware Reconstruction Algorithms: from Radio-Astronomy Imaging to Medical Imaging (MRI)
summary: AMRITA develops image reconstruction algorithms for radio astronomy and MRI.

The project studies how to reconstruct images from non-uniformly sampled data using GPU computation and methods that estimate uncertainty. John Abela leads the project, with Claude Bajada as co-investigator. Xjenza Malta supports it through the Digital Innovation Programme 2026.
